// Private experiment added to Cobra v1.10.2; upstream files retain their licenses.
package cobra

import flag "github.com/spf13/pflag"

// SetInvocationErrorOrigins explicitly selects framework-origin wrappers for this
// command and descendants without their own setting. The default is false; the
// nearest explicit ancestor wins. Configure before execution, like other command
// settings: concurrent mutation of a command tree is not supported.
//
// Opting in changes returned error types and pointer identity, but preserves
// diagnostics, causes and callback input. It does not select an exit code.
func (c *Command) SetInvocationErrorOrigins(enabled bool) {
	c.invocationErrorOrigins = &enabled
}

func (c *Command) invocationErrorOriginsEnabled() bool {
	for current := c; current != nil; current = current.Parent() {
		if current.invocationErrorOrigins != nil {
			return *current.invocationErrorOrigins
		}
	}
	return false
}

// InvocationError identifies a refusal constructed by the command framework.
// It preserves the diagnostic and cause, and does not select an exit code.
type InvocationError struct {
	kind string
	err error
}

func (e *InvocationError) Error() string { return e.err.Error() }
func (e *InvocationError) Unwrap() error { return e.err }
func (e *InvocationError) InvocationErrorKind() string { return e.kind }

func invocationError(cmd *Command, kind string, err error) error {
	if err == nil || !cmd.invocationErrorOriginsEnabled() { return err }
	return &InvocationError{kind: kind, err: err}
}

func invocationFlagError(cmd *Command, err error) error {
	if !cmd.invocationErrorOriginsEnabled() { return err }
	// Inspect the direct parser result, never an arbitrary descendant. Custom
	// Value.Set, Func, BoolFunc, TextVar and Go flag bridges retain caller policy.
	switch e := err.(type) {
	case *flag.NotExistError, *flag.ValueRequiredError, *flag.InvalidSyntaxError:
		return invocationError(cmd, "flags", err)
	case *flag.InvalidValueError:
		if e.IsBuiltinConversion() { return invocationError(cmd, "flags", err) }
	}
	return err
}
